(311)༄༅/ /chu'i bcud len gyi gdams pa 'chi med rig 'dzin sgrub ba'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ // /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (311)༄༅// chu'i bcud len gyi gdams pa 'chi med rig 'dzin sgrub ba'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(312)༄༅// nā mo badzra ḍā ki nī yai/ phyi yi dngos po brlan zhing gsher ba yi// rtsa rnams 'chi med bdud rtsir bsgyur byas te// rgyun gyi btung ba chu nyid longs spyod pas// rig 'dzin bsgrub ba'i bcud len 'chad par bya// de'ang paṇa chen nā ro pa'i slob ma ma hā ri pas lho phyogs dpal gyi rir sgrub pa mdzad pa'i dus mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms par/ ḍā ki nī ro hi ma/ shānti ma/ dum skyes ma/ las grub ma ste bzhis gnang ba'i chu'i bcud len gyi gdams pa karma pa rang byung rdo rjes yi ger bkod cing*/ de nas brgyud pa'i phyag len dben pa bas mdzad pa yang khungs de nyid la thug /birwa ba nas brgyud pa'i sa lugs dang*/ grub chen sa ra ha pa la rnal 'byor mas dngos su gnang ba'i chu'i bcud len su kha pas zin bris mdzad pa ku cor rtogs ldan gyi khrid brgya'i nang na bzhugs pa de bsre bslad ma song ba'i khungs dag par gsal lo// de la gang 'thung rgyu'i chu ni/ mtsho chu dang*/ ba tshwa can dang*/ nyi zla'i 'od ma phog pa'i khron chu sogs ma yin pa blangs nas/ zhag bdun sogs yun ring (313)lon pa'i chu rul rnams dang bskol nas zhag 'das pa ma yin zhing*/ ring nas 'bab pa'i chu klung gtso bo dang*// chu mig gi chu 'jam po la yang rung*// chu mig gi chu mgo nas blangs pa dang*// chu dreg yod pa la mi bya'o// char chu sogs chu'i bzang ngan bshad tshul yang sman rgyud las/ chu ni char chu gangs chu chu klung chu// chu mig khron pa ba tshwa shing gi chu// rim pas dang po mchog yin phyi ma dman// zhes gsungs shing*/ gangs chu ni gangs can las 'bab pa'i chu yin la/ kha ba'i chu spang bya yin par bshad// mkha' las 'bab pa'i char chu ni rang byung gi yan lag brgyad ldan yin te/ rgyud las/ mkha' las 'bab pa ro mi gsal la zhim// 'tsho ngoms bsil la yang bas bdud rtsir mtshungs// zhes dang*/ yan lag brgyad par/

mkha' las 'bab pa gaṅgā'i chu// 'tsho byed ngoms byed yi gar 'ong*// tshim zhing sems ni gsal byed pa// sla zhing ro mi gsal la zhim// bsil zhing yang bas bdud rtsir mtshungs// zhes gsungs te/(314)yan lag brgyad ldan ngos 'dzin tshul yang brgyad stong 'grel chen du/ dri zhim mngar dang bsil ba dang*// yang dang dwangs dang gtsang ba dang*// 'thung na lto dang mgrin pa la// mi gnod yan lag brgyad ldan chu// zhes drangs so// bcos pa'i yan lag brgyad ldan ni// rang byung rdo rjes// chu bskol yan lag brgyad dang ldan// rlung gnon bad kun 'byin par byed// ces dang*/ rgyud las// chu bskol zas 'ju drod skyed skyigs bu sel// bad kan lto sbos dbugs mi bde ba dang*// cham pa rims gsar 'phral du ldog par byed// ces dang*/ paṇa chen zla ba mngon dgas// yul dus lci dang yang ba las// bzhi cha sum cha phed gdu bar// lbu ba med par bskol ba ni// shugs med dri ma med cing phan// zhes so// chus nyes pa skyed pa yang rgyud las// zhag gcig lon nas dug 'dra nyes kun skyed// ces dang*/ rang byung rdo rjes/ chu ni zhag lon nyes gsum skyed// ma gdus khreb po de dang mtshungs// zhes pa ltar ro// gang gis 'thung ba'i gang zag ni// tshe 'di blos btang nas ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su gzhol zhing sgrub pa mdzad 'dod pa la/ mthun pa'i rkyen ma 'dzoms pa'am de la ma ltos pa zhig go /nam 'thung ba'i dus ni/ ston ka ri ṣi 'char ba sogs chu bzang ba'i dus su thog mar bstsams te/ goms nas dus thams cad du chu 'ba' zhig gis 'tsho bar bya'o// ji ltar 'thung ba'i tshul ni/ zas skom la ma ltos par dam chos sgrub pa pos chu 'ba' zhig gis lus rten 'tsho'i thabs su chu'i bcud len la je chung je chung rim gyis goms shing sbyong ba ste/ de'ang rang rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'am phag mo mngon rtogs bzhin bsgom/

chu legs par bskol zhing gdus par rtsam pa thur ma re btab pa bzung nas/ oṃ laṃ laṃ rung rung zhi zhi nyal nyal swā hā/ zhes nyer gcig bzlas pas (315)thugs ka'i phaiṃ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi byin rlabs nus mthu/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub brnyes pa'i drang srong rnams kyi tshe'i dngos grub/ lha'i bdud rtsi'i bcud thams cad bdud rtsi'i 'od zer kha dog lnga'i rnam par bkug nas chu la thim par bsam/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs te btung ngo// oṃ dza le swā hā/ nyer gcig bzlas pas gegs mi 'byung*/ oṃ thud de thud de/ thung ta thung ta swā hā/ nyer gcig bzlas pas srin log spong zhes gsungs/ dben pa pas/ sa ra ha'i 'bebs sbyong gsungs kyang yi ge snga ma rnams su ma byung ngo*// dmigs rim gtso che ba ni/ 'thung bas lus thams cad bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang*/ bdud rtsi spyi bor lud pa las padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i dbus su he ru ka sngon po bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thod pa 'dzin pa/ yum phag mo bum thod 'dzin mas 'khyud pa/ shar du rdo rje/ lhor rin chen/ nub tu padma/ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu thams cad kyang bum thod 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems spyan drangs la thim par mchod cing gsol ba btab pas/ bde mchog gsang gnas dang lha rnams kyi bum thod nas bdud rtsi babs pas lus thams cad bde bas gang zhing nad gdon bkres skom ma lus zhi bar bsam/ lus mi sdod de 'khrul 'khor/ ngag mi sdod de bzlas pa/ yid mi sdod de ting nge 'dzin la brtson par dben pa bas gsungs/ de nas lus gnad bcas la pho ba'i 'khrul 'khor bya zhing*/ brtsan thabs su gtum mo'i thabs lam nyi zla 'bar 'dzag ni/ lte bar nyi ma spyi bor zla ba gnyis dbu ma dang 'brel bar 'bru gsum bsams la/

bum pa can gyi 'bar 'dzag hūm̐ la thim par bsam mo// de yang thog mar nyi ma re (316)re bzhin thun gsum gsum/ zla ba re song nas thun gnyis re/ de nas zla ba re song nas thun gcig gis thub/ rus rnying gi khu ba legs par gdus par mar rnying bu ram tsha ba gsum dang rtsam pa bsres pa'i ril bu byas la/ zla ba dang po'i nyi ma re re bzhin gsum re/ zla ba re song nas gnyis re/ zla ba re song nas ril bu res 'tsho bar nus pa ste/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyis dka' thub mdzad pa'i tshe shug 'bru rim bzhin bzhes pa'i rnam thar dang phyogs mthun pa yin no// rang byung rdo rjes bcud len du chu bskol bar rtsam pa btab par bshad pa ni thog ma nas zas thams cad gcod na bzod mi nus pas rim gyis sbyang dgos ched yin la/ rim gyis legs par sbyangs nas chu 'ba' zhig gis thub nges par myong bas grub bo// dben pa pas/ nyi shu rtsa gcig byas pas brtan pa thob/ de'i rigs la rtsam pa mi gtong*/ brtan pa thob na sha chang la sogs pa kha zas yod pa mi spang*/ med pa mi sgrub/ bcud len 'di lta bu la gnas par bya'o gsungs so// yang na/ lte bar hūm̐ mthing ga /shar du bhrūm̐ ser po// lhor am̐ dmar po// nub tu bam̐ dkar po// byang du kham̐ ljang gu gsal btab pa'am/ rang byung rdo rjes/ zas sred gcod na sa rlung bzung*// mgrin par bhrūm̐ la shes pa gtad// skom sred gcod na chu rlung bzung*// spyi bor bam̐ la shes pa gtad// gos sred gcod na me rlung bzung*// lte bar am̐ la shes pa gtad// rtog pa gcod na nam mkha'i rlung*// snying gar hūm̐ la bzung zhing bsgom// 'dod sred gcod na rlung gi rlung*// mthing ga gsang ba kham̐ la gtad// kun la ma bcos ting 'dzin bsgom// zhes pa gang rung lta bu zhig la dmigs pa gtad pas/ yi ge de las rang mdog can gyi bdud rtsi 'bab pas rtsa thams cad la khyab par bsams la rlung kha sbyor bzung*/

gegs sel (317)ni/ rlung log pa byung na rus khu 'thung bas sel/ yun ring lon nas mngar gsum zos pas stobs 'phel bar 'gyur/ chu skyugs na bu ram 'debs/ chu 'gags pa la sga skya gtang*/ chu snyi ba la gzhug chung gtang*/ rlung langs na za tshod ma bor phor gang*/ dwang ga mi bde na sga/ chu thur byung na phye tshod phor gang gtang*/ mgo 'khor na rus rnying gtang*/ phan yon ni/ rang byung bas/ zhag bdun lon nas nus pa rnyed// nyi shu rtsa gcig brtan pa zin// de nas gegs las thar ba yin// zla ba gcig gis legs par 'byongs// rjen pa'i zas dang grang mo'i chu// gtor bas 'byongs tshad nges pa'o// zla drug 'bad pas yon tan 'char// des na chags med ri khrod 'grims// zhag bdun nyams su blangs pa na// mu ge'i bskal pa dag las thar// nyer gcig kham gyi zas dang bral// lus yang dbugs dal sems mi g.yo// zla gcig zas kyi rtsol sgrub bral// gnyid chung mdangs gsal rmi lam rno// zla drug ngo srung chos brgyad bral// zhes gsungs/ dben sa pas/ mi chags pa gsum ni/ lus la dri ma mi chags/ srin bu mi chags/ mi gtsang ba dang snabs lud mi chags/ 'du ba gsum ni/ nyin mo mi 'du/ nub mo mkha' 'gro 'du/ nang nub zas 'du/ bden pa gsum/ sems la sdug bsngal med pas bden// yid la zhen chags med pas bden// ngag ngan pa'i rdzun med pas bden/ bral ba gsum ni/ sems sdug bsngal dang bral/ lus ngal dub dang bral/ ngag rdzun dang bral/ bde ba gsum ni/ phyi snang ba la zhen pa med de bde/ nang nyon mongs pa la gnyen po mi dgos te bde/ gsang ba 'byung ba cha snyoms pas bde/ mnyam pa gsum ni/ tshe nyi zla dang mnyam/ stobs glang po che dang mnyam/ mgyogs ba rlung dang (318)mnyam/ grol ba gsum ni/ phyi nad las grol/ nang phung po las grol/ bar btang snyoms las grol// zhes gsungs so// //'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud len grub pa las// ring 'tsho'i tshe yid padmo rgyas pa dang*// bsod nams ye shes 'bras bus rab 'byor ba'i// phan bde'i dpal gyis rtag tu dge gyur cig
/ces mang du thos pa'i btsun pa ye shes don grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis yig rnying rnams kyi bcud bsdus pa maṅga lam/// /
